title: Attendance & absences
sourceRightsNote: Synthetic content created for the PolicyLens demo.
summary: A small, clearly labelled policy excerpt for demonstrating grounded answers.

chunks.text: A parent or guardian should notify the school before 9:00 a.m. on a day the student will be absent.
Students should bring an absence note to the attendance office within three school days of returning.

title: Personal devices
sourceRightsNote: Synthetic content created for the PolicyLens demo.
summary: A synthetic device rule used to test evidence and not-found behavior.

chunks.text: Personal phones and smart devices should be silenced and kept in a student bag during lessons unless a teacher gives permission.
A student may use a device for an approved medical or accessibility need after arranging a plan with the school.

title: Accessibility & support
sourceRightsNote: Synthetic content created for the PolicyLens demo.
summary: A synthetic support guide for demonstrating accommodation-related questions.

chunks.text: Students and families can contact the school support team to discuss an accessibility plan for classroom participation.
The support team can review an accessibility plan when a student’s classroom needs change.
